FN-TJYB959-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 291
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator J.T. Waggoner
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/09/2024
Senate Bill 291 as reported by the Committee on County & Municipal Government would
increase the obligations of municipal general funds by an estimated maximum of $450 per
person per year, for certain elected or appointed officials, for terms beginning after January 1,
2025, to cover the cost of 10 hours of annual training during their first term, and by an estimated
maximum of $225 per person per year, to cover the cost of 5 hours of annual training during
subsequent terms. In addition, this bill could further increase the obligations of municipal
general funds by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to compensate officials for
reasonable costs incurred to attend in person training.

FN-TJYB959-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 291
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator J.T. Waggoner
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/17/2024
Senate Bill 291 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of municipal general funds
by: (1) an estimated $450 for the first term of each elected or appointed municipal officials to
attend annual training required by this bill beginning after January 1, 2025; and (2) an estimated
$225 per municipal official per year to attend annual continuing education training. In addition,
this bill could further increase the obligations of municipal general funds by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the reasonable travel costs incurred to attend the in-person trainings
required by this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Ethics Commission,
the Attorney General's Office, and the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to provide
consultation for the development of any training provided pursuant to this bill.
